items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The first impression I had of Horace is a very strange one. I loved the tapping of his feet as much as his playing.

ctx.x: What about Horace Silver? Your first time playing with a guy who would be synonymous with that second generation of hard bop, of bop?
The first impression I had of Horace is a very strange one. I loved the tapping of his feet as much as his playing.
